name: cs-navigator
description: CS Navigator routes to original first-party ChatGPT skills with native-first behavior, verifiable trust boundaries, Brazilian-context profiles, and Skill Containers.

interface.longDescription: CS Navigator 0.9.1 is the unified ChatGPT Skills plugin. It keeps native ChatGPT first, routes explicit CS capability requests through the Navigator, bundles the 0.7.5 Skill Container foundation, and adds original first-party workflows for writing, research, Brazilian context, academic review, design, engineering, visual preservation, project continuity and founder/product strategy. New first-party skills remain evidence-labeled until their final native qualification passes.
defaultPrompt: Help me decide whether this task should stay native or use a CS Navigator skill.
Use CS Navigator to choose the smallest useful workflow for this task.
Show the evidence boundary and unknowns before recommending a CS capability.
